correctness.rationale: Maximal independent sets on C_n correspond exactly to cyclic words with 1-gaps of 2 or 3. The short-gap obstruction for shattered supports proves n≥3k−1, while explicit directed fillings cover n≡0,±1 mod3, so VCdim=floor((n+1)/3). Independently enumerated concepts, all fixed query supports, and every recursive adaptive partition for C3..C13: final table (13,39,VC4,Ldim5), equal VC/Ldim for n3..12. Inspected actual certificate.json: 31 query nodes, 32 leaf witnesses for depth five; 39 concepts rule out depth six. All 1287 C13 five-query supports checked in source and independently no support shattered. Additivity under disjoint products yields 4m vs5m for m C13 components, hence unbounded gap on vertex-transitive 2-regular graphs.

value.rationale: The all-cycle VC formula and sharp C13 first adaptive gap resolve natural graph-learning invariants and yield a vertex-transitive degree-two class with unbounded static-versus-adaptive separation. The exact finite C13 statement is valuable without a claimed general Littlestone formula for n>13.

limitations: General VC formula all cycles/2-regular; complete individual-cycle Littlestone classification only n3..13, not n>13.
The C13 threshold is finite exhaustive, not extrapolation; product separation relies on proven general additivity.
